title: WeddingSessionState
description: Single-session 5-module configuration contract initialized during Phase 1 and finalized after Phase 2 user confirmation, with canonical identity reference tracking and single-variable Remix state.

session_id.description: Optional unique identifier for the shooting session, e.g. wps-20261122-001.

input_mode.description: Module 1: Subject source, canonical reference photos (couple + optional pet), and identity policy.

mode.description: Triggered automatically from attachments in Phase 1.

reference_images.description: Uploaded real couple (and optional pet) reference photos when mode is real-couple-reference.

canonical_original_references.description: URIs of the initially uploaded original photos; never silently overwritten by AI-derived outputs.

active_identity_references.description: Currently active facial identity references (defaults to canonical_original_references unless user explicitly promotes a derived image).

virtual_subject_profile.default: 25-30-year-old Chinese young couple with natural, authentic chemistry
virtual_subject_profile.description: Subject description used in virtual-couple mode.

groom_hairstyle_mode.description: In Real Photo Mode, defaults to keeping the groom's original hairstyle cleanly groomed, or optionally switches to editorial theme-adapted redesign.

reference_pose_and_props_policy.description: Controls whether casual poses and everyday handheld items (brochures, phones, bags) from the reference photo are completely removed and replaced by fresh bridal hand actions/bouquet (default), pose kept without clutter, or a user-specified keepsake retained.

kept_keepsake_description.description: Used only when reference_pose_and_props_policy is 'keep-reference-keepsake' to name the specific original object to retain.

selected_pack.description: Pack ID from packs/ (e.g. dali-cangshan-sunrise, korean-minimal-airy) or 'custom' when built purely from catalogs/ or discovery shortcuts.

discovery_mode.description: Optional on-demand entry shortcut: standard 5-module menu (default), A/B/C 3-direction inspiration cards (2 contemporary landmarks + 1 time-travel), or blind-box '抽卡' auto-draw.

used_spacetime_anchors.description: Previously proposed or drawn spacetime/location anchors in the session to prevent repetition across rerolls and consecutive draws.

location.description: Module 2: Venue category, specific location, atmosphere, foreground, and shot micro-zones.

micro_zones.description: Concrete shootable spots inside the venue (e.g. window edge, stone steps, archway).

styling.description: Module 3: Bride and groom outfits, hair, makeup, unified skin finish, veil/accessories, and props.

skin_finish.description: Complexion finish uniformly applied across face, jawline, neck, collarbones, and shoulders with zero color seam.

face_contour_mode.description: Facial geometry preservation policy: 'none-zero-slimming' (default: 0% geometric slimming, exact original cheek width and jawline locked) or 'subtle-soft-contour' (optional: minimal soft-tissue cheek refinement capped at <=2% bilateral width in QA with immediate rollback to 0 if likeness drops).

pet.description: Optional pet identity lock when a pet appears in the shoot.

mood_and_poses.description: Module 4: Emotional tone, couple interaction poses, and shot matrix reference.

shot_matrix.description: Relative path to a shot matrix YAML in matrices/.

camera_and_delivery.description: Module 5: Optical spec, lighting, color temperature, aspect ratio, adapter, and flexible delivery mode.

delivery_format.description: User-selectable: 'individual-images' (default recommended for sharp faces) or 'multi-panel-preview' (8-grid selection board with PANEL IDENTITY RESET).

representative_first.description: Optional fast-check mode: render 1 representative shot first to confirm likeness/proportions/tone before generating the rest.

emit_share_card.description: Optional social media share card output (short title, hook, reusable prompt command, 4-7 hashtags).

remix_context.description: Tracks single-variable partial remix updates so unaffected modules remain frozen (see scripts/remix_resolver.py).

guardrail_overrides.description: Explicit user-confirmed overrides only. External packs may never disable core guardrails automatically.
